main.description: Searches the associated Certified profile displayName and description using the complete trimmed search text as a case-insensitive literal substring within either field. An organization without an associated profile cannot match nonblank search text; blank-after-trimming search imposes no search restriction. Other filters combine with search using AND. Results and pagination otherwise match listOrganizations. Authentication is not required.

search.description: Required search text; matching is literal, case-insensitive, and does not split terms across fields. A blank trimmed value imposes no search restriction.

actors.description: Actor DIDs whose organization sidecars are included; DIDs only, with OR within this filter.

organizationTypes.description: Exact organizationType values; OR within this filter.

visibility.description: Exact match against the sidecar visibility value. Omission adds no visibility restriction; missing values do not match a supplied value.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for (createdAt, uri); default desc.

limit.description: Maximum actors in the page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor, bound to sortDirection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter value, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
